description: OpsBack connects ChatGPT to your shop so you can look up customers, check jobs, and update job status without opening the dashboard. Ask which jobs are still open, what’s on file for a customer, or to mark a job completed or cancelled. Built for HVAC, plumbing, appliance repair, and other field service shops already on OpsBack. Connect with a shop API key from Shop Settings.

defaultPrompt: What jobs are currently open in my shop?
Show me the full details for my most recent open job, including the customer and service info.
What’s on file for my most recent customer, including notes and past jobs?
